::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/tmtest/form_post"}
#docs
The buyer's browser posts a `next_action.formPost` here on a TM Test Gateway account with `buyer_auth_mode=form_post`. The challenge resolves (approved, or declined with `decision=decline`) and the answer is an HTML page that posts the buyer back to `return_url`. No API key: the `signature` field authenticates the request.

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | A page that posts the buyer back to `return_url` |
| `400` | The signature is not correct |
| `404` | Only available in test mode |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/tmtest/form_post"
```

#response
:::code-group
```text [200 OK]
Content-Type: text/html

<!doctype html>
<html>(the rendered document)</html>
```

```json [400 Bad Request]
    "type": "invalid_request_error",

  }
}
```
